a failed guard throws IllegalMoveException -> cli.displayError(reason), ask again, task not used up
Waiter and Chef choices arrive the same way: readWaiterChoice / readChefChoice -> WaiterChoice / ChefChoice records
Turn 7: the Critic arrives, is seated and orders; first prep unit
Turn 10: Happy Hour starts, then the manager's choice: serve the Critic now?
Turns 11-12: c4 orders during Happy Hour; c3 eats, then pays
Rating.NONE (default hook: only the Critic reviews)
Turns 12-16: c4 is cooked, served, eats and pays the locked Happy Hour price
